owner: CC builds it; cairn/tools/tree owns the tooth
watchme: none, because the fix is a single tooth in a single file and its own green-and-control pair IS the standing check; a probe watching one assertion would be a second copy of that assertion.
children: none, because it is one tooth in one file
sorted_berth: none, because a bug enters directly as a ticket — /intent's own SKILL.md: 'Do not route a bug through here: if editing lines of code fixes it, it is a ticket'. The node class is CairnCommons/node_classes/bug.json, whose pipeline skips THINKME and TICKETME for exactly this case.
intent_berth: none, because a bug enters directly as a ticket — see sorted_berth; the defect's falsifier is the wrong behaviour itself, which is why bug.json calls the design stage optional.
